# MotionBook

> Catalog of 112 open-source iOS motion, transition and UI libraries, maintained by younatics. The MotionBook iOS app runs 64 of them live. Stats as of 2026-10-27.

Use catalog.json for structured data (schema in schema/catalog.schema.json). Each entry has stars, last push, license, latest tag, install lines (SPM / CocoaPods / Carthage), a live-demo flag and the Xcode version it was last verified with. Entries with a live demo also carry `usage`: a minimal Swift snippet copied from the demo source, so it compiles against the pinned version; the same snippet is shown under the library below. Every entry has `tags`: plain search words for what the library does (component names, behaviours, look-alikes such as tinder or apple music), listed after the summary.

## Catalog

- [catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/younatics/MotionBook/master/catalog.json): all libraries, machine-readable
- [catalog.schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/younatics/MotionBook/master/schema/catalog.schema.json): JSON Schema
- [README](https://github.com/younatics/MotionBook#readme): the same list for people
- [Web catalog](https://younatics.github.io/MotionBook/): previews and filters
- [MotionBook app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1205163580): live demos on iPhone

## Libraries

### Animation

- [Lottie](https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios): Render After Effects animations natively and keep product motion consistent across screens. (27K stars, pushed 2026-10-06; live demo, SPM; tags: vector, after effects, json, animation, bodymovin, keyframes)
  LottieAnimationView plays an exported JSON animation; set loop mode or play a progress range.
  ```swift
  private let animationView = LottieAnimationView()

  animationView.animation = LottieAnimation.named("LottieLogo1", bundle: .module)
  animationView.loopMode = .loop
  animationView.play()

  animationView.play(fromProgress: toggled ? 0 : 0.5, toProgress: toggled ? 0.5 : 1, loopMode: .playOnce)
  ```
- [Pop](https://github.com/facebookarchive/pop): Classic extensible animation primitives for spring and decay motion in UIKit apps. (20K stars, pushed 2020-01-02; CocoaPods, archived; tags: spring, decay, classic, physics, animation engine, objective-c, facebook)
- [Spring](https://github.com/MengTo/Spring): A library to simplify iOS animations in Swift. (14K stars, pushed 2023-07-03; live demo, CocoaPods; tags: prototype, easing, spring, animation, uiview, interface builder)
  SpringView (from the storyboard) animates with the animation, curve, force, duration and delay you set.
  ```swift
  ballView.animate()

  ballView.force = selectedForce
  ballView.duration = selectedDuration
  ballView.delay = selectedDelay

  ballView.animation = animations[selectedRow].rawValue
  ballView.curve = animationCurves[selectedEasing].rawValue
  ```
- [SkeletonView](https://github.com/Juanpe/SkeletonView): Today almost all apps have async processes, such as Api requests, long running processes, etc. And while the processes are working, usually developers place a loading view to show users that something is going on.SkeletonView has been conceived to address this need, an elegant way to show users that something is happening and also prepare them to which contents he is waiting. (13K stars, pushed 2026-06-23; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: skeleton, loading, placeholder, shimmer, redacted, table view, collection view)
  Mark views skeletonable, show an animated gradient skeleton while loading, then hide it with a transition.
  ```swift
  stack.isSkeletonable = true

  stack.showAnimatedGradientSkeleton(usingGradient: SkeletonGradient(baseColor: DemoSupport.hairline), transition: .crossDissolve(0.25))
  DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 4) { [weak self] in
      self?.stack.hideSkeleton(transition: .crossDissolve(0.4))
  }

  title.isSkeletonable = true
  title.linesCornerRadius = 6
  ```
- [FLAnimatedImage](https://github.com/Flipboard/FLAnimatedImage): FLAnimatedImage is a performant animated GIF engine for iOS: 1. Plays multiple GIFs simultaneously with a playback speed comparable to desktop browsers 2. Honors variable frame delays 3. Behaves gracefully under memory pressure 4. Eliminates delays or blocking during the first playback loop 5. Interprets the frame delays of fast GIFs the same way modern browsers do (7.9K stars, pushed 2024-03-21; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods; tags: gif, image, animated image, performance, objective-c, flipboard)
  FLAnimatedImage decodes GIF data; FLAnimatedImageView plays it frame by frame with flat memory use.
  ```swift
  private let imageView = FLAnimatedImageView()

  let image = FLAnimatedImage(animatedGIFData: data)

  imageView.animatedImage = image
  ```
- [ViewAnimator](https://github.com/marcosgriselli/ViewAnimator): Animate collection and table view content with concise, reusable item animations. (7.3K stars, pushed 2024-03-31; live demo, SPM; tags: list, collection, stagger, table view, collection view, animation)
  Animate a list of views at once with direction, zoom and rotation animations and staggered timing.
  ```swift
  let animations: [Animation]
  switch picker.selectedSegmentIndex {
  case 1: animations = [AnimationType.zoom(scale: 0.3)]
  case 2: animations = [AnimationType.rotate(angle: .pi / 4), AnimationType.zoom(scale: 0.6)]
  case 3: animations = [AnimationType.from(direction: .left, offset: 60)]
  default: animations = [AnimationType.from(direction: .bottom, offset: 40), AnimationType.zoom(scale: 0.8)]
  }
  let cells = collectionView.visibleCells.sorted { lhs, rhs in
      (collectionView.indexPath(for: lhs) ?? IndexPath(item: 0, section: 0)) < (collectionView.indexPath(for: rhs) ?? IndexPath(item: 0, section: 0))
  }
  UIView.animate(views: cells, animations: animations, duration: 0.6)
  ```
- [Macaw](https://github.com/exyte/Macaw): Powerful and easy-to-use vector graphics Swift library with SVG support (6.0K stars, pushed 2024-02-07; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: vector, svg, drawing, graphics, animation)
  Build a scene graph of shapes, animate their placeVar, opacityVar and fillVar, and play the animations.
  ```swift
  macawView = MacawView(node: makeScene(side: side), frame: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: side, height: side))

  animations.forEach { $0.play() }

  let center = side / 2
  let accent = Color(val: 0xEE165B)
  let ring = Shape(form: Circle(cx: center, cy: center, r: 110), fill: nil, stroke: Stroke(fill: Color(val: 0xE1E4E8), width: 10))
  let square = Shape(form: Rect(x: center - 44, y: center - 44, w: 88, h: 88), fill: Color(val: 0x5C6774))
  let ball = Shape(form: Circle(cx: center + 110, cy: center, r: 22), fill: accent)
  let dot = Shape(form: Circle(cx: center, cy: center - 110, r: 12), fill: Color(val: 0x4ECDC4))
  animations = [
      ball.placeVar.animation(angle: .pi * 2, x: center, y: center, during: 3).cycle(),
      dot.placeVar.animation(angle: -.pi * 2, x: center, y: center, during: 5).cycle(),
      square.placeVar.animation(to: Transform.identity.rotate(angle: .pi / 2, x: center, y: center), during: 2).autoreversed().cycle(),
      square.opacityVar.animation(to: 0.35, during: 1.5).autoreversed().cycle(),
      ball.fillVar.animation(to: Color(val: 0x8E44AD), during: 1.5).autoreversed().cycle(),
  ]
  return Group(contents: [ring, square, ball, dot])
  ```

- [Advance](https://github.com/timdonnelly/Advance): A physics-based animation framework for direct manipulation, gestures, and playful interface motion. (4.5K stars, pushed 2022-05-16; SPM, archived; tags: physics, gesture, simulation, spring, interactive, animation engine)
- [Pow](https://github.com/EmergeTools/Pow): Delightful SwiftUI effects for your app (4.4K stars, pushed 2026-04-13; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM; tags: swiftui, effects, transitions, particles, change effect, animation)
  Change effects fire when a value changes, transitions animate insertion and removal, conditional effects run while a condition holds.
  ```swift
  .changeEffect(.spray(origin: .center) { Image(systemName: "heart.fill").foregroundColor(.red) }, value: likes, isEnabled: isLiked)

  .changeEffect(.jump(height: 24), value: taps)

  .changeEffect(.spin, value: taps)

      .conditionalEffect(.smoke, condition: isSmoking)
  Text("Repeat").demoChip()

      .conditionalEffect(.repeat(.jump(height: 12), every: 1.2), condition: true)
  Text("Push down").demoChip()
  ```
- [Pastel](https://github.com/cruisediary/Pastel): 🎨Gradient animation effect like Instagram (3.5K stars, pushed 2026-03-24; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: gradient, background, branding, instagram, animation)
  PastelView animates a gradient between the given colours; insert it behind your content and start.
  ```swift
  let pastelView = PastelView(frame: view.bounds)
  pastelView.animationDuration = 3.0

  pastelView.setColors([UIColor(red: 156/255, green: 39/255, blue: 176/255, alpha: 1.0),
                        UIColor(red: 255/255, green: 64/255, blue: 129/255, alpha: 1.0),
                        UIColor(red: 123/255, green: 31/255, blue: 162/255, alpha: 1.0),
                        UIColor(red: 32/255, green: 76/255, blue: 255/255, alpha: 1.0),
                        UIColor(red: 32/255, green: 158/255, blue: 255/255, alpha: 1.0),
                        UIColor(red: 90/255, green: 120/255, blue: 127/255, alpha: 1.0),
                        UIColor(red: 58/255, green: 255/255, blue: 217/255, alpha: 1.0)])

  pastelView.startAnimation()
  view.insertSubview(pastelView, at: 0)
  ```
- [Gifu](https://github.com/kaishin/Gifu): Animated GIF playback for UIImageView with frame caching and memory control. (3.2K stars, pushed 2025-08-17; SPM; tags: gif, image, uikit, animated image, uiimageview)
- [Stellar](https://github.com/AugustRush/Stellar): A fantastic Physical animation library for swift(Not Just Spring !!!), it is base on UIDynamic and extension to it, friendly APIs make you use it or custom your own animation very easily! (2.9K stars, pushed 2019-07-31; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive; tags: physics, uidynamics, animation, spring, gravity, snap)
- [paper-switch](https://github.com/Ramotion/paper-switch): RAMPaperSwitch is a Swift material design UI module which paints over the parent view when the switch is turned on. (2.9K stars, pushed 2022-01-25; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: switch, toggle, material design, fill, uiswitch)
- [ConfettiSwiftUI](https://github.com/simibac/ConfettiSwiftUI): SwiftUI Package for Configurable Confetti Animation 🎉 (2.5K stars, pushed 2026-01-05; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM; tags: swiftui, confetti, particles, celebration, effects)
  One modifier per cannon; bump the trigger to fire, pick shapes, emoji or SF Symbols, angles, radius and repeats.
  ```swift
  Button { cannon += 1 } label: { Text("🎉  Cannon").font(.title2.bold()) }
      .confettiCannon(trigger: $cannon, num: 60, confettiSize: 12, rainHeight: 500, radius: 320)

  Button { firework += 1 } label: { Text("🎆  Firework").font(.title2.bold()) }
      .confettiCannon(
          trigger: $firework,
          num: 50,
          confettis: [.text("❤️"), .text("💙"), .sfSymbol(symbolName: "star.fill")],
          colors: [.red, .blue, .yellow],
          confettiSize: 18,
          openingAngle: .degrees(0),
          closingAngle: .degrees(360),
          radius: 220,
          repetitions: 2,
          repetitionInterval: 0.7
      )
  ```
- [Wave](https://github.com/jtrivedi/Wave): Wave is a spring-based animation engine for iOS and macOS that makes it easy to create fluid, interruptible animations that feel great. (2.4K stars, pushed 2026-03-25; live demo, SPM; tags: spring, gesture, engine, animation engine, interruptible, uikit)
  Spring-animate any view's animator properties; pass the gesture velocity so a release continues the motion.
  ```swift
  private let spring = Spring(dampingRatio: 0.55, response: 0.7)
  private let interactive = Spring(dampingRatio: 1.0, response: 0.12)

  @objc private func pan(_ gesture: UIPanGestureRecognizer) {
      switch gesture.state {
      case .began, .changed:
          let location = gesture.location(in: view)
          Wave.animate(withSpring: interactive) {
              ball.animator.center = location
              ball.animator.scale = CGPoint(x: 1.2, y: 1.2)
          }
      case .ended, .cancelled:
          let velocity = gesture.velocity(in: view)
          Wave.animate(withSpring: spring, gestureVelocity: velocity) {
              ball.animator.center = restCenter
              ball.animator.scale = CGPoint(x: 1, y: 1)
          }
      default:
          break
      }
  }
  ```
- [RQShineLabel](https://github.com/zipme/RQShineLabel): A UILabel subclass that lets you animate text similar to Secret app. (1.9K stars, pushed 2023-12-25; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods; tags: label, text, text animation, fade, secret app, objective-c)
  RQShineLabel shines its text in letter by letter; call shine, then fade it out.
  ```objc
  self.shineLabel = ({
      RQShineLabel *label = [[RQShineLabel alloc] initWithFrame:CGRectMake(16, 16, 320 - 32, CGRectGetHeight(self.view.bounds) - 16)];
      label.numberOfLines = 0;
      label.text = [self.textArray objectAtIndex:self.textIndex];
      label.font = [UIFont fontWithName:@"HelveticaNeue-Light" size:24.0];
      label.backgroundColor = [UIColor clearColor];
      [label sizeToFit];
      label.center = self.view.center;
      label;
  });
  [self.view addSubview:self.shineLabel];

  [self.shineLabel shine];
  ```
- [YLGIFImage](https://github.com/liyong03/YLGIFImage): Asynchronized GIF image class and Image viewer supporting play/stop GIF images. It just use very less memory. Following GIF usually will cost almost 600MB memory if it is fully decoded (800x600x389x4 Bytes), but using YLGIFImage, it just use about 30MB memory. (1.8K stars, pushed 2020-12-19; CocoaPods, inactive; tags: gif, image, image viewer, animated image, memory, objective-c)

- [Vortex](https://github.com/twostraws/Vortex): High-performance particle effects for SwiftUI. (1.6K stars, pushed 2026-04-03; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM; tags: swiftui, particles, effects, confetti, snow, fireworks)
  VortexView renders a particle system (built-in presets or custom) from tagged particle views; the reader proxy bursts on demand.
  ```swift
  VortexViewReader { proxy in
      ZStack(alignment: .bottom) {
          VortexView(presets[preset].system()) {
              Circle().fill(.white).blendMode(.plusLighter).frame(width: 32).tag("circle")
              Rectangle().fill(.white).frame(width: 16, height: 16).tag("square")
              Circle().fill(.white).blur(radius: 3).frame(width: 32).tag("sparkle")
          }

  Button("Burst") { proxy.burst() }
  ```
- [Motion (b3ll)](https://github.com/b3ll/Motion): Animation engine for gesturally-driven user interfaces, animations, and interactions on iOS, macOS, and tvOS. (1.5K stars, pushed 2024-10-19; live demo, SPM; tags: spring, gesture, engine, animation engine, interruptible, interactive)
  A SpringAnimation drives a value; update it while dragging, then hand over the velocity and start.
  ```swift
  private let spring = SpringAnimation<CGPoint>()

  spring.configure(response: 0.5, dampingRatio: 0.5)
  spring.onValueChanged { [weak self] newValue in
      self?.ball.center = newValue
  }

  case .ended, .cancelled:
      spring.toValue = restCenter
      spring.velocity = gesture.velocity(in: view)
      spring.start()
  ```

- [RevealingSplashView](https://github.com/PiXeL16/RevealingSplashView): A Splash view that animates and reveals its content, inspired by Twitter splash (1.2K stars, pushed 2025-03-30; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: splash, launch screen, reveal, twitter, logo)

  ```swift
  splash.animationType = types[picker.selectedSegmentIndex]

  splash.frame = view.bounds
  splash.autoresizingMask = [.flexibleWidth, .flexibleHeight]

  splash.startAnimation()
  ```

- [Highlighter](https://github.com/younatics/Highlighter): 🖍Highlight whatever you want! Highlighter will magically find UI objects such as UILabel, UITextView, UITexTfield, UIButton in your UITableViewCell or other Class. (921 stars, pushed 2026-10-25; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: highlight, search, text, uilabel, uitextview)
  Call highlight(text:normal:highlight:) on any Highlightable view; a non-matching query resets it (2.1.1).

  ```swift
  for view in highlightables {
      let normal: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [.foregroundColor: view is UIButton ? DemoSupport.title : UIColor.label]
  ```

  Liquid() is a morphing blob view; samples and period control the shape and speed.

- [AnimateText](https://github.com/jasudev/AnimateText): This library for animating text. Developed with SwiftUI. This library supports iOS/macOS. (432 stars, pushed 2024-02-13; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM; tags: swiftui, text, animation, text animation, typing, typography)
  AnimateText<Effect> animates a bound string letter by letter; reset the text to replay.
  ```swift

  private func replay() {
      text = ""
      DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.05) {
          text = phrases[Int.random(in: 0..<phrases.count)]
      }
  }
  ```

### Transition

- [Hero](https://github.com/HeroTransitions/Hero): Hero is a library for building iOS view controller transitions. It provides a layer on top of the UIKit's cumbersome transition APIs. Making custom transitions an easy task for developers. (22K stars, pushed 2025-01-23; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: transition, navigation, interactive, shared element, material design, view controller)
  Give matching views the same heroID, add heroModifiers, and replace or push view controllers with Hero enabled.
  ```swift
  cell.heroModifiers = [.fade, .translate(x:-100)]
  cell.imageView!.heroID = "image_\(indexPath.item)"
  cell.imageView!.heroModifiers = [.arc]

  hero_replaceViewController(with: next)

  func heroWillStartAnimatingTo(viewController: UIViewController) {
    if let _ = viewController as? GridCollectionViewController {
      tableView.heroModifiers = [.ignoreSubviewModifiers]
    } else if viewController is ImageViewController {
    } else {
      tableView.heroModifiers = [.cascade]
    }
  }
  ```
- [XLPagerTabStrip](https://github.com/xmartlabs/XLPagerTabStrip): XLPagerTabStrip is a Container View Controller that allows us to switch easily among a collection of view controllers. Pan gesture can be used to move on to next or previous view controller. It shows a interactive indicator of the current, previous, next child view controllers. (7.0K stars, pushed 2023-11-22; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: pager, tabs, paging, segmented, container, swipe)
  Subclass ButtonBarPagerTabStripViewController, style the button bar, return child controllers that provide IndicatorInfo.
  ```swift
  settings.style.buttonBarBackgroundColor = .systemBackground
  settings.style.buttonBarItemBackgroundColor = .systemBackground
  settings.style.selectedBarBackgroundColor = DemoSupport.accent
  settings.style.selectedBarHeight = 3
  settings.style.buttonBarItemFont = .systemFont(ofSize: 15, weight: .semibold)
  settings.style.buttonBarItemTitleColor = DemoSupport.title
  settings.style.buttonBarItemsShouldFillAvailableWidth = true
  settings.style.buttonBarMinimumLineSpacing = 0
  settings.style.buttonBarLeftContentInset = 0
  settings.style.buttonBarRightContentInset = 0

  override func viewControllers(for pagerTabStripController: PagerTabStripViewController) -> [UIViewController] {
      [
          PagerChildViewController(title: "Transitions", symbol: "arrow.left.arrow.right", color: DemoSupport.accent),
          PagerChildViewController(title: "Menus", symbol: "line.3.horizontal", color: .systemIndigo),
          PagerChildViewController(title: "Loaders", symbol: "circle.dotted", color: .systemTeal),
      ]
  }

  func indicatorInfo(for pagerTabStripController: PagerTabStripViewController) -> IndicatorInfo {
      IndicatorInfo(title: tabTitle)
  }
  ```

(4.9K stars, pushed 2020-09-20; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, inactive; tags: collection, layout, paging, carousel, transition, collection view)

  ```swift
  }
  ```

- [BubbleTransition](https://github.com/andreamazz/BubbleTransition): A custom modal transition that presents and dismiss a controller inside an expanding and shrinking bubble. (3.3K stars, pushed 2020-11-04; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive; tags: transition, modal, bubble, circular, present)
- [BWWalkthrough](https://github.com/ariok/BWWalkthrough): BWWalkthrough (BWWT) is a class that helps you create Walkthroughs for your iOS Apps. It differs from other similar classes in that there is no rigid template; BWWT is just a layer placed over your controllers that gives you complete freedom on the design of your views. - [SPStorkController](https://github.com/ivanvorobei/SPStorkController): Apple Music style modal presentation: a card that slides up and can be dragged down to dismiss. (2.7K stars, pushed 2023-01-31; live demo, SPM; tags: presentation, sheet, modal, bottom sheet, apple music, card, drag to dismiss)
  Set the controller's transitioningDelegate to an SPStorkTransitioningDelegate and present with .custom style.
  ```swift
  transitionDelegate.customHeight = height          // nil = the default, almost full-height card
  transitionDelegate.showIndicator = true            // grab indicator at the top
  transitionDelegate.swipeToDismissEnabled = true
  transitionDelegate.tapAroundToDismissEnabled = true
  controller.transitioningDelegate = transitionDelegate   // keep the delegate alive: it is a weak reference
  controller.modalPresentationStyle = .custom
  controller.modalPresentationCapturesStatusBarAppearance = true
  ```

- [IBAnimatable](https://github.com/IBAnimatable/IBAnimatable): Design and prototype customized UI, interaction, navigation, transition and animation for App Store ready Apps in Interface Builder with IBAnimatable. (8.6K stars, pushed 2023-02-21; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: interface builder, prototype, design, storyboard, transition, animation)
  Animatable views and labels chain animations with .animate(...).then(...).
  ```swift
  private let box = AnimatableView()
  private let label = AnimatableLabel()

  private func runChain() {
      box.animate(.squeezeFade(way: .in, direction: .down))
          .then(.pop(repeatCount: 1))
          .then(.shake(repeatCount: 1))
          .then(.flip(along: .x))
      label.animate(.slideFade(way: .in, direction: .left)).then(.swing(repeatCount: 1))
  }
  ```

  ```swift
  view.setLabelFontWhen(normal: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 12), selected: UIFont.boldSystemFont(ofSize: 12), disabled: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 12))

  view.alwaysSelected(at: 0)
  ```

  ```swift
      spinner.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: alert.contentView.topAnchor),
      spinner.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: alert.contentView.bottomAnchor),

  alert.present()
  ```

- [folding-cell](https://github.com/Ramotion/folding-cell): FoldingCell is an expanding content cell inspired by folding paper material (10K stars, pushed 2024-04-28; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: table, card, interaction, table view, expand, folding, material design)
  FoldingCell subclasses unfold with unfold(_:animated:completion:); keep the open/closed heights per row.
  ```swift
  if cellHeights[(indexPath as NSIndexPath).row] == kCloseCellHeight {
    cell.unfold(false, animated: false, completion:nil)
  } else {
    cell.unfold(true, animated: false, completion: nil)
  }

  let cell = tableView.cellForRow(at: indexPath) as! FoldingCell

  if cellHeights[(indexPath as NSIndexPath).row] == kCloseCellHeight { // open cell
      cellHeights[(indexPath as NSIndexPath).row] = kOpenCellHeight
      cell.unfold(true, animated: true, completion: nil)
      duration = 0.5
  } else {// close cell
      cellHeights[(indexPath as NSIndexPath).row] = kCloseCellHeight
      cell.unfold(false, animated: true, completion: nil)
      duration = 0.8
  }
  ```
- [SwipeCellKit](https://github.com/SwipeCellKit/SwipeCellKit): Swipeable UITableViewCell based on the stock Mail.app, implemented in Swift. (6.3K stars, pushed 2024-05-19; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: swipe, table view, cell, actions, mail app, drag)

  ```swift
  tableView.register(SwipeTableViewCell.self, forCellReuseIdentifier: "cell")

  cell.delegate = self

  func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, editActionsForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath, for orientation: SwipeActionsOrientation) -> [SwipeAction]? {
      if orientation == .right {
          let delete = SwipeAction(style: .destructive, title: "Delete") { [weak self] _, indexPath in
              self?.items.remove(at: indexPath.row)
          }
          delete.image = UIImage(systemName: "trash")
          let flag = SwipeAction(style: .default, title: "Flag") { _, _ in }
          flag.image = UIImage(systemName: "flag")
          flag.backgroundColor = .systemOrange
          return [delete, flag]
      }
      let read = SwipeAction(style: .default, title: "Read") { _, _ in }
      read.image = UIImage(systemName: "envelope.open")
      read.backgroundColor = DemoSupport.accent
      return [read]
  }

  func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, editActionsOptionsForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath, for orientation: SwipeActionsOrientation) -> SwipeOptions {
      var options = SwipeOptions()
      options.expansionStyle = orientation == .left ? .selection : .destructive
      options.transitionStyle = .border
      return options
  }
  ```

- [YNExpandableCell](https://github.com/younatics/YNExpandableCell): ✨Easiest usage of expandable & collapsible cell for iOS, written in Swift 3. You can customize expandable UITableViewCell whatever you like. YNExpandableCell is made because insertRows and deleteRows is hard to use. You can just inheirt YNTableViewDelegate and add one more method func tableView(_ tableView: YNTableView, expandCellAt indexPath) -> UITableViewCell? (451 stars, pushed 2026-10-24; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage; tags: table view, expandable, collapsible, cell, accordion)
  YNTableView with YNTableViewDelegate: return the expanded cell and height per index path.
  ```swift
  @IBOutlet var ynTableView: YNTableView!

  func tableView(_ tableView: YNTableView, expandCellWithHeightAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> YNTableViewCell? {
      let ynSliderCell = YNTableViewCell()
      ynSliderCell.cell = tableView.dequeueReusableCell(withIdentifier: YNSliderCell.ID) as! YNSliderCell
      ynSliderCell.height = 142

      let ynSegmentCell = YNTableViewCell()
      ynSegmentCell.cell = tableView.dequeueReusableCell(withIdentifier: YNSegmentCell.ID) as! YNSegmentCell
      ynSegmentCell.height = 160

      if indexPath.section == 0 && indexPath.row == 1 {
          return ynSliderCell
      } else if indexPath.section == 0 && indexPath.row == 2 {
          return ynSegmentCell
      } else if indexPath.section == 0 && indexPath.row == 4 {
          return ynSegmentCell
      } else if indexPath.section == 1 && indexPath.row == 0 {
          return ynSegmentCell
      } else if indexPath.section == 1 && indexPath.row == 1 {
          return ynSliderCell
      } else if indexPath.section == 2 && indexPath.row == 2 {
          return ynSliderCell
      } else if indexPath.section == 2 && indexPath.row == 4 {
          return ynSliderCell
      }
      return nil
  }
  ```
